home.weekendText: Collect on Friday or Saturday, return on Monday morning: you only pay for one day.
home.helpSubtitle: Choose your project, and we’ll show you the right equipment.
home.step1Text: Just once, for the whole order. We check the availability of all the items at the same time.
home.step2Text: Suitable machinery, accessories and consumables. Collection from the depot or delivery to the site.
home.step3Text: Online or for collection via Click & Collect. Your equipment is ready, checked and serviced.
home.packsTitle: BricoPacks — everything you need for a building site
home.packsText: Ready-to-use packages, designed for private individuals: one task, one pack, one price.
home.adviceText: Got a question about the right tool, a breakdown or a missing accessory? Our team is here to help.
home.brandsTitle: Leading brands in the construction industry
home.ctaText: Hundreds of professional machines, bookable online 24 hours a day.
home.faqPriceA1: By the day, by the week (4 times the daily rate) or by the month (12 times the daily rate). The dates specified in the order determine the period for which the invoice is issued.
home.faqPriceA2: A card hold: the amount is reserved but not debited, and is released upon return if everything is in order. For Click & Collect, the deposit can be paid in cash.
home.faqPriceA3: Yes, the rates are on a sliding scale and a discount is automatically applied for business customers.
home.faqDeliveryQ1: Click & Collect – how does it work?
home.faqDeliveryA1: You book online, we prepare the equipment, and you collect it from the Ruisbroek depot (Sint-Pieters-Leeuw) during opening hours.
home.faqDeliveryQ2: Do you deliver to building sites?
home.faqDeliveryA2: Yes, within the service area. The fare is calculated automatically based on your address (distance from the depot).
home.faqDeliveryA3: Collect on Friday or Saturday, return on Monday morning: only one day will be charged.
home.faqGearA1: Each machine is individually tracked, serviced and inspected before every hire.
home.faqGearA2: Basic accessories are included. Suitable consumables (bits, discs, sandpaper, etc.) are listed on each product page.
home.faqGearA3: We assess the damage on return; only the cost of repairs is charged, which is deducted from the deposit.
home.heroTitleAccent: For exactly as long as you need.
home.heroLead: Checked professional equipment, available today. Book in a few clicks, pick up in 2h or get it delivered anywhere in Belgium.
home.degressiveText: The rate drops automatically with duration. No codes, no hidden maths.
home.appText: Book, extend and track all your rentals. Even mid-project.
home.testimonialQuote: I book in the evening, I pick up the next morning. It has become my first reflex before buying.
home.statToolsSub: machines and tools available near you
home.diffTitle: We make it simple for you
home.diffDeliveryTitle: Delivered to your door, collected from your home
home.diffDeliveryText: We’ll deliver the materials to your doorstep and come back to collect them. The price is based on the distance from our Ruisbroek depot — no need for a van, so you can save your time for the building site.
home.diffDeliveryPoint1: Delivery slot selected at the time of ordering
home.diffDeliveryPoint2: Or free collection from the depot, if you prefer
home.diffPackText: One job, one package, one price. All the tools you need for a building project, all in a single booking — for homeowners who don’t want to have to think about it.
home.diffComposeText: Nothing fits exactly? Build your own pack machine by machine — from 3, the discount applies automatically.
